entries.title_en: Project funded under the NWO–FAPESP Merian Fund call
entries.title_pt: Projeto financiado pela chamada Merian Fund NWO–FAPESP
entries.body_en: REACH Nexus has been selected as one of five Brazilian–Dutch consortia funded under the NWO–FAPESP Cooperation Brazil–The Netherlands 2024 call "Extreme Heat and Water Events: Mitigating the Adverse Health Effects of Climate Change in Cities." The five-year programme begins on 1 January 2026 and is jointly led by Reinout Wiers (UvA) and Leandro Giatti (USP).
entries.body_pt: O REACH Nexus foi selecionado como um dos cinco consórcios Brasil–Países Baixos financiados pela chamada NWO–FAPESP Cooperação Brasil–Países Baixos 2024 "Extreme Heat and Water Events: Mitigating the Adverse Health Effects of Climate Change in Cities." O programa de cinco anos inicia em 1º de janeiro de 2026 e é co-liderado por Reinout Wiers (UvA) e Leandro Giatti (USP).
